title: FGR Opens Investigation After Soldiers Enter Pregnant Woman's Home in Nuevo Laredo
excerpt: Mexico's federal prosecutors opened an investigation after a 23-year-old woman who is nine months pregnant reported that soldiers entered her Nuevo Laredo home without showing an order, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo.
content:
Mexico's federal prosecutors have opened an investigation after Priscilla Jasso Romero, 23, who is nine months pregnant and due in about two weeks, reported that soldiers entered her home in the Arboledas neighborhood of Nuevo Laredo without showing an order, according to El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo.

The Fiscalía General de la República (FGR) opened investigation file FED/TAMP/NVO.LAR/0001943/2026 for the alleged crime of allanamiento, or unlawful entry, after receiving the complaint in its Célula IV-3 office. The Federal Public Ministry will gather testimony and evidence, clarify the circumstances, identify those involved and determine whether criminal conduct occurred.

According to Jasso Romero's account, she was lying down when three military trucks arrived at her home. Four uniformed soldiers with their faces covered entered the house and searched the rooms, she said, telling her the property had been reported — but without showing an order or explaining who reported it or why.

She said the soldiers made remarks she found intimidating, which increased her fear, and that they did not initially believe she was pregnant, so she had to physically show them her belly. She said she was very frightened, her belly became very hard from the fright, and she considered seeking a medical check for herself and the baby.

She is asking for an investigation, a guarantee of her safety, for responsibilities to be established and for human rights to be respected. The report did not give a separate date for the entry itself, only the Nov. 13 report date, and it did not include a response from military authorities. No charges have been filed, and the investigation is ongoing.

Source: El Mañana de Nuevo Laredo (elmanana.com.mx) — “Investiga FGR allanamiento de militares en vivienda de mujer embarazada” (Nov. 13, 2026). elmanana.com.mx
